texts.en:
We have received disturbing reports from the [preftl_slavers_country.GetName] [GetPreFTLUpperPlural]: in remote regions of the planet, several spacefaring merchants, mainly smugglers, have disappeared along with their ships. A discreet investigation revealed that they were pressed into work in the mines, far from view.

It is important to note that this was not done by the [preftl_slavers_country.GetName] authorities, but rather a few local warlords and criminals, and that all of the abducted individuals were in violation of the treaties we signed with the [GetPreFTLUpperPlural].

# 被奴役 / Enslaved

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-12
- 来源 Sources：`events/first_contact_dlc_events.txt:9334-9404`；`common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:468, 538-560`（on_five_year_random_pulse_pre_ftl）；`events/on_action_events_2.txt:3146-3179`（action.620/621）

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 每五年的国家检查运行 action.620：拥有“首次接触”DLC、且与某个前超光速文明有生效协议的普通帝国，会在 0–360 天后抽取“前超光速外交事件池”（无事 200，本事件 10，条件不满足的事件被跳过）。
  The five-year country pulse runs action.620: a regular empire with the First Contact DLC and an active agreement with a pre-FTL civilization draws from the pre-FTL diplomacy pool 0-360 days later (nothing 200, this event 10; events whose conditions fail are skipped).
- 条件：与非“挣脱桎梏”母族的前超光速文明有贸易协议；每个帝国一次。
  Conditions: a trade agreement with a pre-FTL that is not our Broken Shackles parent; once per empire.
- 发生后设置“近期前超光速外交事件”冷却，其他此类事件暂不出现。
  Afterwards a "recent pre-FTL diplomatic event" cooldown blocks the other events of this pool for a while.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 8050「被奴役」：前超光速文明在偏远地区扣押并奴役了失踪的星际商人（多为走私者）。
  8050 "Enslaved": in remote regions the pre-FTL civilization has captured and enslaved vanished spacefaring merchants (mostly smugglers).
- 选项：“咎由自取”；为他们争取自由；发动惩戒打击（若干当地人口死亡）。单页事件。
  Options: "they got what they deserved"; secure their freedom; launch a punitive strike (several natives die). A single window.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 这是可重复抽取的随机外交插曲之一（各事件本身每个帝国通常一次），与同池其他事件没有固定顺序。
  One of the random diplomacy interludes of this pool (each usually once per empire), with no fixed order relative to the others.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 与 8045 同名但方向相反。
  Same title as 8045 but the reverse situation.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对：触发与选项。
  Checked: trigger and options.
